bundle.shortDescription: Military-grade encrypted P2P messenger over Tor
bundle.longDescription: Vchat is a peer-to-peer encrypted messenger that routes all traffic through the Tor network. No servers, no tracking, no metadata collection. Each user runs their own Tor hidden service. Messages are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key exchange uses X25519 ECDH, and the Noise protocol provides mutual authentication.
